name: The Next Step
summary: Elder Aetheen turns south after the beasts near Thendal Village are dealt with. The Al'Aketh Cult's zealots threaten Shen'dar Village.

sections.title: Leaving Thendal Village
sections.body: Elder Aetheen of the Gales sees danger growing across Zephras Isle. The predators and matriarchs of the northern wilderness have been dealt with, but that was only the lesser trouble. Outlying settlements still need defenders.

sections.title: The Looming Shadow of the Cult
sections.body: The Al'Aketh Cult is the chief danger in southern Zephras. Its ruthless zealots worship Al'Akir the Windlord, ruler of Skywall in the elemental realm. Their growing power threatens Shen'dar Village. Aetheen sends travelers south along the road, past ambushers in the highlands, to aid Constable Aonda's local guard.

faq.answer: The road runs south from Thendal Village through the Shen'dar Highlands to Shen'dar Village. Constable Aonda oversees the village's defense.
Constable Aonda holds civic and military authority in Shen'dar Village. The constable keeps order and protects the village from growing cultist threats.
The Al'Aketh are ruthless zealots on Zephras Isle who worship Al'Akir the Windlord, ruler of Skywall. Their growing power threatens the island's settlements.
Al'Akir the Windlord rules the skies and commands Skywall. Air elementals revere him, and the Al'Aketh Cult worships him fanatically.

faq.q: Why does Elder Aetheen send travelers away from Thendal?
faq.answer: With the immediate threats around Thendal handled, Aetheen sends proven defenders to Shen'dar Village. The Al'Aketh Cult's advance endangers the island far more than the troubles around Thendal.

faq.q: What hazards are along the road to Shen'dar Village?
faq.answer: The trail south crosses the Shen'dar Highlands. Al'Aketh Ambushers and rogue cult thugs harass travelers moving between the island's settlements.

angles.text: For the Skyborne, facing the Al'Aketh means fighting elemental fanaticism that threatens settlements across their home on Zephras Isle.
As a shaman, you know the danger of mortals blindly worshiping elemental lords like Al'Akir. His volatile nature often demands servitude rather than balance.
